title: Evidence viewer and economic relationship view
scope: Display evidence citations, page/record references, relationships and clearly marked disputed matches

acceptance.text: Display evidence citations, page/record references, relationships and clearly marked disputed matches
Browser tests navigate finding-to-source and show uncertain ownership without implying guilt

verification: Browser tests navigate finding-to-source and show uncertain ownership without implying guilt

evidence.text: Case detail has Evidence, Relationships and Findings tabs and a record page (/auditor/cases/:caseId/evidence/:evidenceId). Evidence and entities load through listEvidence/listEntities (src/api/caseRecords.ts); findings come from the one listFindings client in src/api/review.ts (TAX-042), whose parser now also checks citation hashes and locators, finding kinds and the approval flag. Citations show document, version and page/record locator and link only when the cited SHA-256 matches the stored original. Relationships show parties, ownership and payments from FtM entities; yente candidates are labelled unreviewed/confirmed/rejected with 'A similarity score is not identity'; ownership cited by an unresolved finding is marked 'Uncertain: records disagree' with every stake shown as recorded. Discrepancies and missing evidence are separate groups. Fixture: listEvidence/listEntities from integration/api/fixtures/case_records.json; the TAX-041 findings are seeds in case_review.json, and every served citation resolves to a stored hash. After merging TAX-042: 76 auditor unit tests and 66 contract tests pass.

apps/auditor-web/e2e/evidence.spec.ts (Playwright, Edge, fixture server): a finding citation opens the record page at 'Cited location: Page 3' with the full SHA-256, and 'Back to the finding' returns focus to that finding; a record locator (row 4) is followed by keyboard only; three ownership rows are marked 'Uncertain: records disagree' with 60%, 55% and 40% shown as recorded, and the page contains none of fraud/guilt/evasion/suspicious/offence/wrongdoing/abuse; discrepancies and missing evidence are separate groups; superseded version, failed extraction, empty, unknown and denied states. After merging TAX-042: auditor browser suites 41 passed (desktop and review projects; 17 opt-in screenshot captures skipped); tests/frontend harness 93 passed at 1440, 1024 and 390 px.

npm run check passes (lint, format, typecheck, unit tests, both builds, frontend-test typecheck). With the venv Python: validate, contract.py (24 examples), contracts (66), integration, data, ai and backend pass; ruff check passes; mypy passes on 149 files. tests/tooling has 2 existing Windows-only file-permission failures (0o666 vs 0o600) unrelated to this change. Review PR #157.

docs/evidence/TAX-041 (recaptured after merging TAX-042): evidence, relationships and findings tabs and two record pages at 1440/1024/390 px; loading, empty, denied, unavailable and not-found states at 1440/390 px; focus on a citation link and focus returned to a finding (Edge, Windows). axe WCAG 2 A/AA and 2.1 AA: no serious or critical violations on the three tabs and two record pages. Wide tables scroll inside labelled focusable regions. Visual approval is left to the reviewer.
